hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. The batch requested a refund of 5261 cents for order 121, but list_refunds shows only refunds for orders 122 (5470) and 124 (1085). The handoff also reports only 122 and 124 as applied, so the order 121 refund was never applied. Payouts would be based on net balances that don't reflect this refund. Please have Alpha Co confirm or apply the order 121 refund before any payouts are recorded.
